_comment: Versioned E10.2 operational repair pilot ONLY: first100 frozen requests/model; exact archived binary; no full pool, candidate or evaluation. V1 failure untouched.

jobs.name: e10_self_pilot_v2
cmd: set -eu; out="$1"; mkdir -p "$out"; for f in tinyllama_server self_output_pool.py self_output_pilot_v2.py self_output_vm.sh pick.gguf pk.gguf pick_pool.jsonl pk_pool.jsonl pick_table.bin pk_table.bin COMMITS INPUT_SHA256SUMS; do cp "/content/chat/upload/$f" "/content/$f"; done; rc=0; bash /content/self_output_vm.sh || rc=$?; cp /content/vm.log "$out/vm.log"; if [ -s /content/out.zip ]; then cp /content/out.zip "$out/out.zip"; fi; if [ -s /content/out/pilot_summary.json ]; then cp /content/out/pilot_summary.json "$out/pilot_summary.json"; fi; exit "$rc"
